salary_details.details: The monthly remuneration payable shall be fixed as per the formula of “Last Pay minus Pension", excluding Dearness Allowance (DA). The amount of remuneration shall remain unchanged for the entire term of the contract, and no annual increment or percentage increase shall be admissible during the contract period. An appropriate and fixed amount towards Transport Allowance for commuting between the place of residence and the place of work shall be allowed, not exceeding the rate applicable at the time of retirement. The amount so fixed shall remain unchanged during the entire term of appointment.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Delhi Cantonment Board to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Hospital Administrator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Hospital Administrator position is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Hospital Administrator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired/superannuated officers of the Army Medical Corps (AMC) holding the rank of Colonel or above, with at least 05 years of experience in Hospital Administration.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Hospital Administrator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Hospital Administrator post in the Delhi Cantonment Board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official Delhi Cantonment Board website.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Hospital Administrator position?
faq.answer: The age ceiling for the continuation of the contract is 65 years as on the date of renewal of the contract.

faq.question: Q6. How is the salary determined for the Hospital Administrator?
faq.answer: The salary is fixed as per the formula "Last Pay minus Pension", excluding Dearness Allowance (DA). A fixed transport allowance is also provided.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Hospital Administrator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Hospital Administrator post will be through an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DCB/IT/HA/2026.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contract-based position.
